compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** 2f28c680656e7166d4c704163d760fd04c3ed95b
* **test:** tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh :: test_design_notes_output

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Pre-existing test failure (caught by sprint test gate)

#### Expected Behavior
tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh passes on the session/main HEAD (89/89).

#### Actual Behavior
On clean session HEAD 2f28c68065 (no local edits), the suite reports PASSED: 89 FAILED: 1 with the single failing case test_design_notes_output. The failure is pre-existing and reproduces with no working-tree changes.

Secondary impact (why surfaced now): record-test-status.sh maps any plugins/dso/skills/**/SKILL.md edit to the FULL skills test set via an over-broad test->source mapping, so an unrelated fix-bug/SKILL.md change (sprint task 315a-77fb under epic waxen-sigma) pulls test-onboarding-skill.sh into its gate and harvest-worktree.sh blocks (exit 2) on a failure the change did not cause. Relates to epic c13f-6196 (irrelevant test->source mappings).

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh
* record-test-status.sh test->source mapping breadth

comments.body:
fix-bug:investigation

VERDICT: STALE — resolving commit b5002d83645da3e15c38e07a69a4fdf90f4d7273 (2026-06-02)

## Reproduction

Test passes on current HEAD (PASSED: 90, FAILED: 0). The failure was introduced on code_version 2f28c680 and has since been fixed.

## Root Cause

The test checked for the STALE literal 'design-notes.md'. The SKILL.md had already migrated its artifact reference to 'DESIGN.md' (the new default for the design.design_notes_path config key). The test's grep pattern was not updated to match, producing a false-negative.

This was a TEST-side defect (stale expectations), NOT a production regression.

Failing assertion (pre-fix):
  File: tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh line 395
  grep -q 'design-notes.md' (stale pattern — no match in SKILL.md)
  assert_eq: expected 'found', got 'missing'

## Resolving commit

b5002d83645da3e15c38e07a69a4fdf90f4d7273
  fix(tests): update onboarding test_design_notes_output for DESIGN.md migration
  grep pattern changed from 'design-notes.md' to 'DESIGN.md'
  Suite result: 90 passed, 0 failed

## Classification

UPDATE (test-side fix; stale expectation updated to match migrated contract)

## Recommendation

This ticket should be closed — the fix is already merged to main (HEAD). The test now passes.
